recipes.title: Peach iced tea
recipes.author: Sam Okonkwo
directions: Steep the tea in 2 cups of hot water for 5 minutes, then discard the bags.
Stir in the honey until it dissolves, and add the remaining cold water.
Slice the peaches and muddle a few slices in the pitcher.
Chill, then serve over ice with the rest of the peaches.

recipes.title: Lemon pasta
recipes.author: Jonah Ellis
directions: Boil the pasta in salted water until just tender.
Warm the olive oil with the garlic until fragrant, then take it off the heat.
Toss the drained pasta with the oil, lemon zest, lemon juice, and Parmesan.
Season with salt and pepper and serve right away.

recipes.title: Weeknight chili
recipes.author: Ada Lovelace
directions: Brown the turkey with the onion in a wide pot.
Stir in the chili powder and cook until it smells toasty.
Add the tomatoes and beans and simmer for 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Tomato soup
recipes.author: Priya Shah
directions: Warm the oil and soften the onion and garlic.
Add the tomatoes and broth and simmer until the tomatoes break down.
Blend until smooth, then season with salt.

recipes.title: Skillet cornbread
recipes.author: Maya Chen
directions: Heat a skillet in a 425°F oven with the butter until it melts.
Stir the cornmeal, buttermilk, egg, and salt into a thick batter.
Pour the batter into the hot skillet and bake until the top is golden, about 20 minutes.
